guesses.breed: American Pit Bull Terrier / American Staffordshire Terrier
guesses.reason: Broad blocky head, wide muzzle with a strong jaw, short sleek fawn-and-white coat, and a stocky, muscular build are classic bully-breed traits.
Compact, sturdy body with a short muzzle and pronounced cheek muscles fits a Staffy influence.
Fawn coat with a white chest and blaze, slightly darker muzzle shading, and naturally large erect ears could suggest some Boxer in the mix.

breed.appearance: A compact, muscular medium-sized dog with a short, glossy fawn (light tan) coat, a white blaze running from forehead down the muzzle, and a broad white chest and white-tipped paws. Her large, naturally upright pointed ears are pink inside, her eyes are warm amber-brown with soft grayish-dusky shading around them and on the muzzle, and her black nose sits above a muzzle with pink freckled patches on the lips. She wears a pink collar with a silver tag and is shown sitting attentively, looking up with an earnest expression.
breed.fun_fact: Pit bull–type dogs are famous for their big smiles, wiggly bodies, and boundless love for their people!
